registryEvidence.localCustodian: Ondo State Ministry of Lands and Housing / Office of the Surveyor General is the evidenced state land-survey custodian, and the official survey-plan procedure lists an Owo area lands office at Ministry of Works Yard, GRA along Iyere Road, Owo.
registryEvidence.basis: The official Ondo State survey-plan PDF names the relevant state MDAs, describes survey data capture and filing/verification by the Office of the Surveyor General, and lists the Owo area office. The current LandsApp provides public information and land/survey service workflows but requires account access for applications and does not expose parcel geometry.

requests.outcome: Official PDF downloaded and read. It records the Ondo State land/survey workflow and explicitly lists the Owo area lands office; it contains no public parcel geometry endpoint.
Official Ministry LandsApp landing page loaded. It exposes public information, documents, and service navigation; no parcel layer or geometry endpoint was present in the returned HTML.
Public portal home loaded. Returned scripts and markup exposed no anonymous parcel/map API; no login or account creation was attempted.
Public land and survey service catalogue loaded. It describes applications and verification workflows but did not provide safe anonymous parcel IDs, polygon geometry, CRS, or a public map service.
Public documents page loaded; no downloadable parcel dataset or map service was exposed.
Official Ondo State services page loaded and confirmed land-title search and land-survey services, but no anonymous parcel geometry service was identified.
ArcGIS Online search returned no verified first-party Owo parcel layer; non-indexed or non-ArcGIS services are not excluded.
A bounded exact-WUP-point OSM parcel-tag query was rejected before data; this is not evidence of parcel absence.
